text:
maya: Heads up — canary showing big main-thread jank when opening Heatmap with "similarity" overlay enabled. Repro on Chrome/FF. Flame chart shows long GC + layout passes.

maya: Timeline: open dashboard -> hover over a row -> UI blocks for ~700-900ms, frames dropped. A bunch of XHRs for /meta/models and a large script eval (~350KB) right before the jank.

sam: ugh. saw perf spike in last canary. Any idea which asset? bundle sizes on sourcemap look normal but eval cost could be from a new embed lib.

liam: I dug into sourcemap: embed-similarity-lib@3.1.0 was rolled in yesterday — +320KB minified and adds synchronous WASM instantiation on import. That would explain the eval pause.

elaine: Also telemetry client is now calling /routes/metadata per-panel on mount (new sampling telemetry change). Each panel mounts -> extra network + JSON parse. Combine that with the big sync WASM import and you get the freeze. HAR attached in thread (snippet):

```
GET /routes/metadata 200 28ms
GET /embed-lib.wasm 200 60ms
eval embed-similarity-lib.js (synchronous) 345ms
forced reflow 410ms
```

sam: thanks, good find. two separate problems: (1) sync wasm import in embed lib, (2) telemetry metadata per-panel. Which one is highest priority?

maya: both. customer-facing bug — interactive heatmap unusable on big boards. we should hotfix to unblock canary.

liam: quick mitigation: lazy dynamic import of the similarity lib only when overlay toggled. E.g. 
```
const similarity = await import(/* webpackChunkName: "embed-sim" */ 'embed-similarity-lib');
// then init wasm async
```
That avoids sync eval on initial panel mount. I can open a PR.

elaine: for telemetry, we should reduce the sampling and stop metadata fetch on mount. Instead defer to background worker or get data from existing store. I'll draft a tiny change to make telemetry metadata lazy + cache at route-level.

ops-bot: deploy canary: frontend-canary-20240308-14 started by @liam.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout triggered: canary=frontend-canary-20240308-14 -> 3% traffic.

sam: propose sequence: 1) liam PR for dynamic import hotfix (patch) 2) elaine PR to stop per-panel metadata + add simple in-memory cache (minor) 3) roll canary to 20% if green. Any objections?

maya: +1. liam please mark as high-priority and add test cases for toggling overlay under high-row-count dashboards. Also add perf test script used to repro.

liam: will do. PR target: master -> hotfix. I'll also add telemetry flagguard if we need immediate revert.

elaine: I'll put the metadata change behind a feature flag too, so we can toggle without another deploy.

sam: assign owners: liam (embed lazy load), elaine (telemetry metadata), maya (QA + perf harness). I'll follow up with release notes and rollback plan.

maya: thanks all. tagging SRE in case we need to throttle canary traffic: @ops if we hit more customer reports, be ready to pause. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ack. Monitoring alert created: heatmap/main-thread-jank-high.

maya: summary action items in thread: liam PR, elaine PR, QA perf run, canary ramp. We'll reconvene after canary results.
